svg.title: Dark Green Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid screen colours. Six-sided indented support traced by eye from the oblique museum photograph; depth omitted and contour approximate.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://collection.themodern.org/objects/1781/dark-green-panel; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
